description: This file defines error-related enums, structs, and constants used for handling authentication and gateway responses within the openclaw project. It contains specific error codes, error structs, and associated logic for error handling in gateway connections.

classes.name: GatewayConnectAuthError
classes.description: Represents an authentication error during gateway connection, including message, detail code, next step, and retry information.

classes.name: GatewayResponseError
classes.description: Represents an error response from the gateway indicating failure, including method, code, message, and details.

classes.name: GatewayDecodingError
classes.description: Represents an error during decoding of gateway responses, including method and message.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.init
methods.description: Initializes a GatewayConnectAuthError with message, detail code, retry flag, and optional recommended next step. Trims whitespace from inputs and provides default message if input is empty.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.init
methods.description: Alternate initializer accepting slightly different parameter names for convenience.

methods.name: GatewayResponseError.init
methods.description: Initializes a GatewayResponseError with method, code, message, and details (defaults missing values).

methods.name: GatewayDecodingError.init
methods.description: Initializes a GatewayDecodingError with method and message.
